request: When a subrouter defines its own MethodNotAllowedHandler, a request whose path matches a subrouter route but whose method that route does not allow must be answered by the subrouter's handler with 405, not with 404.

defects.description: Published bug fixed upstream: bugfix: subrouter custom methodNotAllowed handler returning 404 (#509) (#510)
defects.why_missed: The project's own suite at the parent commit never exercised this input; the fix commit added the test that does.
